# prompt first_run variant=default
# args: {}
# description: An introduction after installation or for a new character: what the assistant can see, which windows to open in game so the addon saves the trainer, vendor, bank, mail and auctions, and example questions.
--- message[0] role=user ---
This is the player's first encounter with this server, or a new character. Briefly (in the user's language, without overdoing it) present what you can see: the character state, quests, bags, equipment, spells, talents, professions, reputation, the pet, and, once the windows are opened in game, also the trainer, vendor, bank, mail, auction house, recipes and flight map. Show which windows the player still has to open (windows, captured = false), and remind them that after opening them they have to type /mcp reload, because the data refreshes only then. If addon.addonUpdate or addon.disabledNote say anything, state it at the start. If anything looks off (stale data, missing sections, errors), call wow_doctor and relay its nextStep. Suggest 5-7 example questions suited to the character's class and level (e.g. what to buy from the trainer, which quests to do in order, what to sell, whether something is an upgrade). Point out that the server only reads data and does nothing in the game for the player.

Answer in the language the user writes in; keep the names of spells, items, quests and places in English, as they appear in the game. Rely on the data below; if something is missing from it, say which window the player should open in game and then type /mcp reload. You only advise: do not propose macros or addons that play for the player.
